import json, subprocess
def run(doc):
    p=subprocess.run(['python3','submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)
def base_model(C=2,E=1,K=1,cw=None,cb=None,cshift=None,dw=None,db=None):
    le=[[i] for i in range(16)]; ge=[[0] for _ in range(16)]
    if cw is None: cw=[[[1,0]]]
    if cb is None: cb=[0]
    if cshift is None: cshift=[0]
    if dw is None: dw=[[0],[1]]
    if db is None: db=[0,0]
    return dict(classes=C,embedding_dim=E,length_embedding=le,gap_embedding=ge,kernel=K,
        conv_weights=cw,conv_bias=cb,conv_shift=cshift,dense_weights=dw,dense_bias=db)

# timeout boundary
cfg=dict(slots=1,window=1,idle_timeout=5,len_quantum=1,gap_quantum=1,rate_num=1,rate_den=1,
         bucket_capacity=512,initial_tokens=512,pending_capacity=512,lanes=1,service=[1,1],
         fallback=0,time_edges=[0],count_edges=[0],probability=[[65536]])
doc=dict(version=1,config=cfg,model=base_model(),
    connections=[dict(id="a",slot=0,label=0,split="dev")],
    packets=[dict(time=0,connection="a",length=0,draw=0),
             dict(time=5,connection="a",length=0,draw=0),  # gap=5 >=5 -> reset gen2
             dict(time=9,connection="a",length=0,draw=0)]) # gap=4 <5 -> same gen2
o=run(doc)
print("TIMEOUT gens:",[p["generation"] for p in o["packets"]])

# token saturation + tokens decision
